0022600022.text: The Timberwolves (3-2) host the Clippers (1-3) in their sixth game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup. Minnesota enters on a two-game losing streak, third in the Northwest and one game back, while the Clippers, on a three-game skid, are fourth in the Pacific and 2.5 games back. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), who is averaging 33.3 points and 33.7 minutes this season, and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while the Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery), with Rui Hachimura day-to-day and a game-time decision because of quadriceps soreness. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, after splitting their 2-2 series in 2025-26, and their last meeting was on March 11, 2026, in Los Angeles, when the Timberwolves lost 153-128.
